title: A corner helper
prompt: Draw a square of 40 with a `corner` helper, so that `run` is only four lines.
hints: corner moves forward 40 and turns left; run calls corner four times. Anything you repeat can become a function.
`func corner():` with the two calls inside.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	corner()
	corner()
	corner()
	corner()

func corner():
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
